entries.0c28dc6b8dcc5a0f: This service runs craft events that bring creators and users together in person. It holds "HandMade In Japan Fes'", described as Japan's largest festival of creators, held at Tokyo Big Sight, and "Creema YAMABIKO FES", an outdoor festival combining music and crafts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥166 million.
entries.0e35f0986a83b0bb: Creators who use advertising functions and membership services
entries.32ca33bbd762cb31: A company that offers services supporting creators' creative activities, centered on "Creema," a handmade marketplace.
entries.3a2ff5297b98d8dd: This service provides marketing support for creators, companies and local governments that open shops, using the platform and user base of "Creema". It offers external advertising for companies and local governments as clients, in-house advertising for creators called "Work Promotion", the subscription-type "Creator Push", and the "Speed Transfer Service" for members, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥716 million.
entries.4e80f2714334c310: This is a group of new services that support creators' creative activities. It provides the crowdfunding service "Creema SPRINGS", through which creators and manufacturers can raise funds for projects, and the lesson video platform "FANTIST", operated by consolidated subsidiary FANTIST Inc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥196 million.
entries.bb3d8c578dd289fd: This is a single-segment business of the company group, which consists of the company, one domestic subsidiary and one overseas subsidiary, a total of three companies. It provides a venue where creators engaged in creative activities and consumers (users) can buy and sell original works directly online, and supports creators' activities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2,535 million.
